prompt: Which abstract class requires subclasses to implement calculatePay()?
choices: abstract class Employee { abstract double calculatePay(); }
final class Employee { double calculatePay() { return 0; } }
explanation: abstract class with abstract method: subclasses must implement calculatePay() or be abstract themselves. Option A is a concrete class — subclasses can but don't have to override. Option C is an interface (valid but not a class). Option D is final — cannot be extended.
